notes: A field claiming to measure 'demonstrated use' of a supplied knowledge item by a generated response must be populated ONLY by a real extraction step reading the response's OWN output — never inferred from the mere fact that the item was supplied/selected/offered. Context presence is not evidence of use.

The minimum auditable mechanism for this is: (1) instruct the generator to cite a stable, per-item marker inline when it materially relies on that item; (2) after generation, parse the output for marker-shaped tokens; (3) INDEPENDENTLY VERIFY each found marker against the set of markers ACTUALLY offered to that call — a marker not offered is a fabricated citation, excluded from the credited set and counted as a diagnostic, never silently accepted or silently dropped without a trace.

This verifies citation VALIDITY (was this genuinely among what was offered) but not deeper citation TRUTHFULNESS (would the answer change if the item were removed — an ablation study). That gap must be stated as a documented limitation of the mechanism, never silently assumed closed.

When comparing two treatments that both receive contextual material through the SAME serializer, any information shown to the model that is not part of the treatments' registered, load-bearing difference (e.g. metadata like validation/reputation scores marked 'lifecycle-only, cannot affect the in-call answer' in a Mechanistic Difference Enumeration) must be withheld from BOTH treatments' prompts — never added to one only to 'reflect its own runtime', since that silently introduces a new, unauthorized explanatory mechanism.

Discovered via EXP-P1's execution rehearsal: prior to this fix, `actuallyGroundedInvariantIds` had already been found once (same day) to be a naive copy of the selected/offered set; this invariant generalizes the LESSON from that repair into the POSITIVE construction required once a real generator call exists, so the next harness that adds real execution doesn't have to rediscover the same distinction from a fresh audit.

canaries.assertion: citation extraction credits only markers the arm was ACTUALLY offered; a fabricated marker is excluded from actuallyGroundedInvariantIds and counted as a diagnostic; demonstratedUseRecall is computed from actuallyGroundedInvariantIds, never from selectedInvariantIds (a citation to an offered-but-not-ground-truth item scores 0, proving the metric is not gameable by selection size alone).
Arm B and Arm C prompts never render standing/confidence/reach — lifecycle-only metadata withheld from both treatments identically, never added to one to explain its own runtime.

statement: A 'demonstrated use' field must be populated ONLY by extracting real evidence from a generator's OWN output — via a stable per-item citation marker, self-reported inline by the generator and then independently verified against the set of markers actually offered to that call — never inferred from context presence (supply/selection) alone. A cited marker not among what was offered is a fabricated citation: excluded from the credited set and counted as a diagnostic, never silently accepted or dropped. This verifies citation VALIDITY, not deeper TRUTHFULNESS (no ablation is implied) — state that gap explicitly rather than assuming it closed. When two treatments share a serializer, withhold any non-load-bearing metadata (e.g. lifecycle-only scores) from BOTH prompts identically; never add it to one treatment only to explain its own mechanism, since that introduces a new, unauthorized, unregistered explanatory signal.

occurrences.defect: Before this module, no evidence-of-use extraction step existed anywhere in EXP-P1's harnesses (actuallyGroundedInvariantIds was always null); this occurrence is the first POSITIVE construction of the invariant, not a repair of a prior violation of it.
